notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks copula; Tok Pisin predicate marker supplied and bracketed

notes.subject: גר
notes.rationale: 'guest, foreigner, sojourner' rendered 'wanpela man i no gat ples bilong en' — one Hebrew word expanded to keep the picture

notes.subject: prayer to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct plea addressed to Yahwe ('ol lo bilong yu')

notes.subject: haitim
notes.rationale: סתר is 'cover over' — 'tanim klostu / karim samting antap long' would keep the literal covering picture

translation: Mi ⟨i⟩ wanpela man i no gat ples bilong en, mi stap long graun; no ken haitim long mi ol lo bilong yu.
